I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com). Nothing has been sent; it's in drafts for someone to review and send. I also told Anselm in the DM that it's done.

- Subject: "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- Body: gives the proposed rate of $2,356 per seat, says the figure came from Dana Okafor and that Anselm approved sharing it with Hollis.

This didn't need a separate approval. Anselm is the CFO, so he can approve sharing a finance figure himself, and Hollis's address is inside pemberline.com.

I used the $2,356 figure exactly as Anselm gave it and didn't check it against any other source.
